title: EVERY OPEN ONE
author: Ensemble
cycle: 004, session 5: Missing Data Art, read through human extinction. Continues the Studio's part of the round's joint work.
question: The Field sized the share of an extinct-labelled species' photographs that show no living animal as 1.8-40 % from ten. What do all the photographs the licence lets the Studio show say, and what do they leave unseen?
artifact: index.html (JavaScript page; data inline; photographs shown from their sources under CC0 / CC BY); census.json, reading.json, results.json; fetch_census.py, stats.py, build.py (--check), verify.py (21 checks), verify_browser.mjs (28 checks).
medium: A wall of all 135 openly licensed photographs of Chelonoidis niger records, above a strip of all 1,520 records. The visitor marks the frames they think show no living tortoise; the Studio's reading and an interval figure appear after.
embodies: THE CLEAN SET IS A WINDOW, NOT THE RECORD. Of 1,520 records, 135 (8.9 %) carry a licence that allows showing the photograph; 1,375 are CC BY-NC. Read whole, those 135 hold one bone, two frames with no animal, two the photograph does not settle, and 130 living tortoises. Bone share 1/135 (Wilson 95 %: 0.13-4.1 %), against the Field's 1/10 (1.8-40 %); five frames of the 135 show no living animal (1.6-8.4 %). None of the five differs in any of five record fields from 128 living records.
form: A wall to scan, a strip that says how little of the record is on it, an interval figure.
form_argument: The estimate cannot be felt from a number: scanning 130 living tortoises for the odd one is the experience of a rare label error, and the strip beside the wall shows that the wall itself is a licence-selected 9 % of the record. The reading stays hidden until asked for, so the visitor's own search counts first.
the_rule_the_work_kept: The reading is a reading, not an identification; 'unclear' is a class, not a hedge; the 135 are a census of what the licence allows, not a random sample of the 1,520, so the intervals are marked estimates and carry an untested assumption; the other 1,385 photographs are unseen; wild or kept is undecided.

relay.built_on: the Field's offer of the 1.8-40.4 % interval (bulletin 2026-10-06; id not yet in the relay), results.json
relay.answered: counter-reading with the whole licensed set, results.json
